req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that every /tasks/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) GET /tasks/ returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (2) POST /tasks/ returns 201 with application/json (EP positive), (3) GET /tasks/{id} for existing task returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (4) PUT /tasks/{id} returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (5) GET /tasks/{id} for non-existent task returns 404 with application/json error body (NEG — error paths must also be JSON), (6) POST /tasks/ with invalid payload returns 422 with application/json (NEG), (7) DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with no body — Content-Type assertion is skipped but status is exact (BVA boundary — the one endpoint that must NOT return a body). We assert the exact content-type string 'application/json' to catch mutations that change the header value, and assert exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded task rows
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a JSON array
trace: R-TASK-025: all /tasks endpoints returning a body must use application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)

test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_task_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Valid TaskCreate payload is provided
actions: Send POST /tasks/ with a valid JSON body {title: 'Buy groceries', completed: false}
trace: R-TASK-025: POST /tasks/ returns a body and must use application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_task_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

test_post_task_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_get_tasks_content_type_exact_value
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded task rows
actions: Send GET /tasks/ and inspect the full content-type header value
trace: R-TASK-025: exact content-type value must be application/json, not a similar but wrong type
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_content_type_exact_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert ct.startswith("application/json")
    assert "text/html" not in ct
    assert "text/plain" not in ct
    assert "application/xml" not in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_get_tasks_content_type_exact_value()

tests.name: test_post_task_max_length_title_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Boundary-valid row: title exactly 100 chars (max_length), description exactly 500 chars (max_length)
actions: Send POST /tasks/ with title of exactly 100 characters and description of exactly 500 characters
expected: Response body contains the task with the exact title and description provided
trace: R-TASK-025: POST /tasks/ at boundary payload sizes must still return application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_task_max_length_title_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    title_100 = "X" * 100
    desc_500 = "X" * 500
    payload = {"title": title_100, "description": desc_500, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == title_100
    assert body["description"] == desc_500
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body

test_post_task_max_length_title_returns_json_content_type()
